checks.name: Action-token binding
checks.output: 5 tests pass. stored_form() does not contain the minted secret, starts with the marker 'h:' and is deterministic. resolve() at the bound revision succeeds; at revision 4 it returns ConnectorError::TargetRevisionChanged{bound_to:3,current:4} rather than re-targeting; at or past expiry it returns TokenExpired; for a different actor id and for a same-id actor in another tenant it returns ActorNotEligible; expired.category() != ineligible.category() (token_expired vs actor_not_eligible). Caveat recorded rather than hidden: stored_form is a 64-bit FNV-1a fold that the module doc itself calls "a non-cryptographic stand-in for the real digest", so "stored hashed" holds only in the weak sense that the stored value is not the token; it is not preimage- or collision-resistant.
